definitions.gloss: good omen; auspicious sign; lucky sign
definitions.explanation: A sign or event believed to foretell something good. Used in both traditional and modern contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吉兆|きっちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rainbows are considered a good omen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吉兆|きっちょう}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Seeing a crane on New Year's is said to be an auspicious sign.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧、⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{吉兆|きっちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧がした。
examples.english: The weather was fine from morning, and it felt like some kind of good omen.

notes:
{吉兆|きっちょう} combines ⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧ (good fortune) + ⟦{兆|ちょう}→兆：17936_chou⟧ (sign, omen). A somewhat literary or formal word for an auspicious sign.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吉兆|きっちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be considered a good omen)
- {吉兆|きっちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兆|きざ}し→兆し：06633_kizashi⟧ (signs of a good omen)
- {吉兆|きっちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}なす→見なす：10615_minasu⟧ (to regard as a good sign)

TRADITIONAL GOOD OMENS IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧ (cranes) — longevity and good fortune
- ⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧ (rainbows) — bridges between worlds
- ⟦{初夢|はつゆめ}→初夢：16702_hatsuyume⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富士山|ふじさん}→富士山：09514_fujisan⟧ (Mt. Fuji in first dream of the year)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{凶兆|きょうちょう}→凶兆：20365_kyouchou⟧: bad omen (direct antonym)
- ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: auspicious, lucky (everyday equivalent)
- ⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧: good fortune (used in ⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧/fortune-telling: ⟦{大吉|だいきち}→大吉：19336_daikichi⟧, ⟦{中吉|ちゅうきち}→中吉：29072_chuukichi⟧)

REGISTER:
More formal/literary than ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧. Common in written language and cultural contexts.
